import tarfile
import io

def tar_basic(name, data):
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=buf, mode='w') as tf:
        info = tarfile.TarInfo(name=name)
        info.size = len(data)
        tf.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(data))
